title: Prepare the first bounded research brief and H1 source panel
objective: Create a traceable, anti-copy research plan and a balanced first source panel that Olli can approve in one short review.

included: Taste Reverse operational stabilisation and sanitised export boundary
Five human-selected sources at deep depth
Capture scope, evidence limitations, originality boundaries, and H1 decision packet
excluded: Broad source capture before H1 approval
Promotion of external expressions into Mez rules
Canonical token, component, Figma, or production implementation

acceptance: Eight ranked questions and five approved deep sources are recorded
Each source has a study purpose, anti-copy boundary, official URL, and limitation
The amendment and its coverage trade-offs are explicit
The packet structure, source balance, question mapping, and provisional Taste Reverse boundary pass deterministically

verification.passCondition: Eight questions, five deep sources, approval evidence, anti-copy boundaries, and the provisional export contract pass.
Olli approves or amends the reference panel at H1.

humanGate.approvalQuestion: Approve the reference panel, or add, remove, or hold a source?

stopConditions: Do not begin broad evidence capture without recorded H1 approval.
Do not treat any source as a Mez visual direction or copy its signatures.
Do not describe Taste Reverse as Git-pinned until its initial repository checkpoint is approved and created.
notes: H1 approves research priorities only. H2 later selects or rejects cross-channel north-star directions.
